newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TMM buys part of Colombian shipping firm.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TMM buys part of Colombian shipping firm.

text.p: Mexican transport giant Transportacion Maritima Mexicana (TMM) said it would announce shortly the purchase of part of Colombian shipping company Flota Mercante Grancolombiana for $20 million.
TMM investor relations head Pedro Mejorada told Reuters TMM and Flota Mercante would form a new subsidiary incorporating some Grancolombiana shipping assets.
TMM would have 60 percent of the new company and Grancolombiana 40 percent.
Mejorada said the new company would incorporate Grancolombiana assets such as a minority stake in a Cartagena port terminal and a majority stake in a stevedoring company.
The deal would not include the purchase of any Grancolombiana ships, he added.
"Basically we are buying market," Mejorada said.
He said TMM would pay $10 million in cash with the remainder to be financed.
Grancolombiana was expected to make an announcement in Bogota shortly.
